x_axes.reason: Elapsed time includes0 and z spans2..20; logarithmic x is not needed for these saved grids.

redshift_panels.curve_coordinates: Each curve retains its own saved z values.
redshift_panels.top_mapping: Use the group reference case monotonic saved z versus elapsed_s; place reference-time ticks at interpolated reference z. Reference times increase left-to-right.

time_panels.curve_coordinates: Each curve uses ITS OWN saved elapsed_s converted to Myr.
time_panels.top_mapping: For readable reference-z ticks within saved reference support, interpolate their times on reference history and place them on the bottom time axis. No top ticks beyond reference time support.

x_axes.reference_label: Every figure must state exact reference case ID and: Auxiliary axis uses reference clock; other cases have different z(t).
x_axes.mapping_method: Piecewise-linear interpolation of actual saved monotonic coordinates; reverse descending z before interpolation. Do not solve another background or assume one universal mapping.
x_axes.domain_policy: Mask out-of-reference-support ticks; no extrapolation, endpoint clamping, or fiction of actual case-specific conversion. Curves may extend beyond reference support without extra top ticks.
x_axes.validation: Verify finite strictly monotonic reference elapsed_s and z in opposite directions; check endpoint mapping and a saved interior knot numerically.
x_axes.shared_panels: A shared physical x-axis allows a top auxiliary axis on the top row of each column plus a figure-wide reference-clock note. Do not place top labels where they overlap facet titles.

abundance.internal_coordinates: Retain direct log10(Y) values for very small nuclear inventories; do not exponentiate before plotting and do not apply a second logarithmic transform.
abundance.tick_formatter: Display plotted coordinate k as 10^k using mathtext; use explicit fractional exponent if an automatically selected tick is noninteger.
abundance.label: Y = n_species/n_B (log scale)
abundance.zero_policy: Initial/genuine zero is not positive and cannot be placed on log axis; annotate its omission. Unresolved T charge entries remain blank labelled UNRESOLVED.

signed.scale: symlog base10 with exact zero visible, positive and negative branches retained
signed.fraction_difference_linthresh_meaning: Display transition chosen from recorded observed comparison scale, not an error bar, certified noise floor or data correction. Preserve cold-family unresolved label.
signed.other_linthresh_rule: For a panel M=max(abs(all finite displayed signed ordinates)); if M>0 choose linthresh=10^(floor(log10(M))-2); if M=0 use a finite benign1e-12 and annotate allzero. Control residuals use this panel rule, not the fraction-difference comparison scale.
signed.linthresh_display: State linear-region |y|<=linthresh in each signed panel or a compact legible figure legend/table keyed by panel.
signed.no_abs_substitution: Do not replace signed quantities by absolute values to fit a logarithmic axis.

positive_geometry.zero_policy: Omit exactzero points from logarithmic ordinate and annotate them; do not add a positivity floor. If allzero annotate instead of generating invalid limits.
positive_geometry.small_dynamic_range: Retain accurate values and readable ticks; no data-dependent renormalization that changes meaning.

y_axes.unchanged: Preserve every data value, case selection, scientific label, initial matching and observed-control interpretation.

acceptance.all_trajectory_figures: Both physical coordinate labels visible via the primary plus reference-clock auxiliary axis; actual case-specific time curves preserved.
axis_checks: Reference time conversion is Myr, not Gyr.
Nuclear log10 values remain representable; no log-of-log.
Signed differences still show negative, zero and positive values.
Exact reference case and differing clocks disclosed.
No omitted case or changed scientific dataset.
acceptance.visual_review: Inspect representative abundance, ionic, tiny difference, signed context and strongest-control panels after rendering. Check top axes/titles do not overlap and exponent tick labels remain readable.
acceptance.scope: Display-only review/addendum; scientific contracts and measured numbers unchanged except clarifying units/axes.
acceptance.stop: One render pass plus at most one targeted display repair; no new physics run.

explicit_overrides.prior_forbid_common_secondary_time_axis: A disclosed reference-clock auxiliary axis is now required. A common axis falsely presented as the physical clock of every case remains forbidden.
explicit_overrides.prior_time_unit_Gyr: Display time in Myr; physical elapsed_s arrays remain unchanged.
explicit_overrides.prior_log10_y_label: Keep log10 numerical coordinates but show physical abundance tick labels10^k and Y(logscale).
